Upadacitinib is a new treatment preparation for Inflammatory Bowel Disease (IBD). In 2024, it received a new treatment code in the [[landspatientregisteret|Landspatientregisteret]] (LPR), the Danish national patient registry [^src1]. This administrative update is significant for clinical tracking, as it enables the inclusion of upadacitinib in the DANIBD report's Indicator 5 data, which monitors quality metrics such as F-calprotectin measurements for patients receiving medical therapy [^src1].

The 2024 DANIBD report documented this methodological change alongside the registration of several other modern biologics and JAK inhibitors. Specifically, upadacitinib was added to the LPR at the same time as [[filgotinib|filgotinib]], [[risankizumab|risankizumab]], [[mirikizumab|mirikizumab]], and [[ozanimod|ozanimod]] [^src1]. This broader integration of new treatment codes was part of a detailed analysis of medical and surgical quality data, highlighting progress in meeting national development goals for IBD care and improving the tracking of treatments across regions and departments [^src1].
